contracts.docstring: Fresh owner instruction with an exact optional prior-code input selection, never inherited approval.
Host-recorded source and explicit relative paths, without replacement bytes or asserted native context.
Reject ambiguous paths and source identities at the HTTP boundary before filesystem access.
Owner preview of selected bytes against a specifically registered canonical source.
Exact observed selected-file data for the next native admission.
Keep the original file selection immutable when moving from HTTP to admission policy.
Original owner request with optional observed prior code as attributed data.
List recorded old file origins for explicit owner choice, without inferring task ownership from a legacy agent label.
Observe only selected bytes from an actual registered origin; this preview starts no process or inference.

Freeze tracked/nonignored private edits in fresh metadata with one exact admitted parent.

Only the host's credential-free Git policy and owned process executor are
used. Author config, index flags, refs and commits cannot select the candidate
tree or parent. Root .ken metadata is excluded; a base tracking that reserved
path and gitlink candidates require explicit policy and are refused. Reserved
legacy .worktrees storage cannot be published as authored code. Complete
binary diff output is bounded at one MiB; overflow fails without truncating
evidence. The caller must fence/close writers before capture and bind the
returned identities to its durable attempt/context before delivery.
Read retained native material or selected older files and freeze owner-chosen data using the existing admission receipt transaction.
Bind an exact earlier-code or selected-file observation and the same registered source to fresh development.

Clone an exact committed source into a fresh private attempt directory without sharing metadata.

Dirty/hidden-index sources, linked/shared metadata and submodules need explicit
policy before admission; they are refused without editing or deleting anything.
Untracked root .worktrees is preserved legacy storage, never cloned code;
a base tracking that reserved namespace is refused rather than hidden.
The returned copy is only a preparation dependency. Runtime lease binding,
writable capsule admission, durable recovery and candidate publication belong
to the native controller and must be wired before enabling development tasks.
Validate a bounded explicit selection; metadata, traversal and recursive discovery never expand its scope.
Exact owner-observed old source and selected paths; original input may remain explicitly unknown.
Validate neutral selection identity before receipt lookup or any filesystem operation.
Retain actual file identity, mode and change indicators without inferring a Git commit or author.
Pin every directory component from the filesystem root without following symlinks or reopening selected names.
Read one selected regular file, literal symlink target or observed absence with bounded nonblocking descriptors.
Resolve stored source identity and observe selected bytes without modifying files, starting processes or assigning historic task ownership.
Reuse existing run persistence; file data will be retained by its ordinary admission receipt.
List stored candidates for owner selection; a legacy agent label does not demonstrate task ownership or file availability.
Resolve only host-recorded paths in their true project/repository scope; never use an arbitrary caller path.
Freeze two equal selected-path observations; do not claim an atomic Git tree, ignored-file discovery or physical writer closure.
Inspect selected data without claiming work, admitting a run or executing Git/config from an old worktree.
Own durable admission, fenced attempts and version-bound review requests in SQLite.
Keep historical ordinary intents stable and bind exact review or earlier-code input selections.
Consume actual delivered prior bytes when selected; the controlled fresh author applies them with Git in its private copy.
Generate controlled independent review calls; every source/proposal/Git/closure operation remains production code.
An authored candidate must not turn preserved legacy storage into tracked product code or hide it in a later base.
Treating old per-agent directories as dirty code would make real file import impossible without editing the original ignore rules.
Only the untracked reserved namespace may survive outside the clone; actual code changes still block admission.
Record a real directory with a legacy Git pointer; no native execution or historic task ownership is fabricated.
Following Git pointers or inventing a historic task mapping would import credentials or attribute unrelated work.
Re-reading old live files on retry would lose the selected material or silently change a committed request.
An explicit file selector must not expand into metadata, credentials or paths outside its registered directory.
The export must refuse unsafe reads and foreign origin before storing any request or mutating original data.
Missing native context must not destroy recoverable private bytes or be replaced by current requirements.
A label or client-supplied origin cannot replace the scoped source packet at either owner entry.
Validate the changed fixture contract cheaply before launching its long kernel/Git integration.
Observe the controlled reviewer advancing beyond unknown original input without opening any real tool.
Fresh authoring and explicit prior-code reuse keep original receipts, independent checks/review and an unchanged source.

scope: New/changed Python definitions and modules in this delivery. Relevant new frontend modules and exported helpers also carry English JSDoc; no claim that all historic project definitions are documented.
